description: Golden geometry and clock parameters for localization tests (localization.md Phase 0). Synthesis happens in-memory at test time from these parameters; no audio is committed. Ranges below are exact Euclidean distances; tests assert recovery within stated tolerances, never exact equality.

session_clock.note: Single-interface rig: one offset and one small skew shared by every take (Mode A).

multipath_case.note: Reflection stronger than nothing but weaker than direct; Q3 must keep the direct arrival.

noise_case.note: White measurement noise at the coherent-use threshold; ranges must stay within widened sigma.
